factor_name: Volatility-scaled blended cross-asset residual reversal (3/5/7 sessions)

calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, average three volatility-scaled residual reversal signals based on completed 3-, 5-, and 7-session returns relative to the same-date cross-sectional median. The factor is evaluated before the next completed daily return and uses no future information. Dates require at least eight valid instruments.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC and ICIR remained positive across 2020-2022 (0.056673/0.169712), 2023-2024 (0.031757/0.096438), and 2025-2026 (0.040961/0.129021). Predictive power is primarily next-session and decays by ten sessions. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
